design_rules: No reference, oracle, inspection or demonstration trajectory is stored in this catalog.
No obstacle placement rule reserves a route tube or clear lane.
World is 100 x 40 m with z in [0.5,6.0] m and a 96 m nominal start-goal separation.
Four physical boundary walls are visible to depth/LiDAR and participate in collision.
Field obstacle targets are 50 easy, 100 medium and 150 hard, excluding boundary walls.
Two staggered non-solid blocking bands intercept constant-y straight shortcuts while leaving weave-through connectivity.
Reachability is accepted only from offline 3D occupancy A* metrics; path coordinates are discarded and never exported.

MIGHTY.used_as_reference_for: ~105m end-to-end navigation and long-corridor dynamic obstacle placement; trefoil-style moving obstacles

SANDO.used_as_reference_for: 100x40m paper benchmark footprint and 105m route; trefoil motion semantics
